scoring_justification: Mean relative differences are recomputed from the frequency rows; convergence thresholds are checked.

hidden_assets.purpose: Convergence thresholds for N_α=4 and N_α=6 derived from paper Appendix C text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Phys. Rev. B 99, 205133, Appendix C: 'accuracy is improved to five digits for N_α=4 and six digits or more for N_α ≥ 6'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted relative error thresholds (1e-4 for 5 digits, 1e-5 for 6 digits) from the statement on digit accuracy.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Direct translation of the paper's stated convergence accuracy; no invented numbers.

outputs.description: The checker will extract the mean relative differences for N_alpha=4 and N_alpha=6, verify they are below specified accuracy thresholds, and confirm the mean relative difference decreases monotonically with increasing N_alpha.
